question: Do the desk's entries whose name moved fewer than 8 spreads in the 21 minutes before the buy (range in bp / full SIP spread paid at entry < 8) lose more than the desk's other entries on sessions the exploration never saw?
operator_sentence: Operator 2026-10-29 ~05:20 ET in chat, after the slope_now replay exploration (9/28-10/13), to the offer to check the under-8-spreads split on the sealed 10/14-10/27 trades tonight: 'Yes, check it'.
registered_at: 2026-10-29 ~05:30 ET, before any held-out trade is priced or its range computed.
origin: Exploration (tools/studies/slope_now_explore.py, ~/replay_runs/slope_now/explore.json, 12 sessions 9/28-10/13, 231 REF trades, mean net -3.4 bp): range_per_spread [4,8) n 26, mean -10.8 bp, win 19%, day t -3.0; [2,4) n 3, -19.2; [8,16) n 65, -3.0; >=16 n 89, -4.0; missing (no warehouse bars) n 48, +2.2. The cut-off 8 is taken from that table and fixed here. The 10/27-10/28 desk-trade examples discussed in chat (FE etc.) motivated the feature; 10/28 is therefore excluded from the hold-out.
prior: Weakly for: a name that barely moves cannot pay its spread (cost is the spread). Against: the exploration is one 12-session sample with 29 low trades; split-and-cut-off chosen on it shrink out of sample; the RTH history (slope_now_hist) showed narrow range only ~-0.3 bp gross.
sessions: The sealed sessions 2026-10-14, 10-15, 10-16, 10-19, 10-20, 10-21, 10-22, 10-23, 10-26, 10-27 (10) - the REF replays already in ~/replay_runs/slope_now (pinned 5d3ff370, run 10/29 in explore-only mode). 10/28 is excluded (seen in chat).

measure.trades: Every REF trade (closed or open_at_end), priced as slope_now_explore / stale_age_read: entry at the first SIP trade within 60 s of the replayed decision, exit at the replay's exit (open_at_end at the SIP 15:49 close), net = gross - full SIP quoted spread at entry (replay_costing.entry_spread_bp). No SIP print or no NBBO = trade dropped (counted).
measure.range: % range (high / low - 1) of the 21 completed IEX 1-minute bars before the minute of the trade's ARM_OK row (the same join as slope_now_explore: last ARM_OK row at or before entry within 90 s). Bars from the warehouse where present, else from Alpaca historical IEX 1-minute bars (the warehouse ends 2026-10-15); fewer than 15 bars in the window = range missing (counted).
measure.move_to_cost: range in bp / entry spread in bp. LOW = move_to_cost < 8; REST = move_to_cost >= 8. Missing range or spread = excluded from both groups (counted and reported with its own mean).

statistic: Per session: d = mean net(LOW) - mean net(REST), on sessions with at least one LOW and one REST trade; sessions equal-weighted, day-clustered (std_scorer.day_stat), one-sided bounds at 0.975, t at n-1 df.
pass: The split HOLDS only if ALL: (1) mean d <= -5 bp with t <= -2.0; (2) LOW's pooled mean net < 0; (3) >= 20 LOW trades over >= 6 sessions; (4) removal beats random: within each session, remove the same number of trades at random from all trades (1,000 seeded draws, 'MTC-k'); the book's mean net after removing LOW exceeds the random-removal mean in >= 95% of draws.
underpowered: Fewer than 20 LOW trades or 6 sessions with LOW: UNDERPOWERED (direction only).
fail: Short of HOLDS: the split is not supported out of sample; no filter is built from it.
if_holds: Not a switch-on. It earns a replay gate test (a knob refusing arms whose move_to_cost < 8 at the arm, with a matched random refusal and forward sessions, under the '2 bp + average >= 0' rule), pre-registered separately; the arm-time spread there must be the order-time quote, not the 16-min SIP reading.
information_only: LOW vs REST win rate; mean net of the missing-range group.
script: tools/studies/move_to_cost_holdout.py (count, then score), reusing slope_now_explore's join and pricing, written after a result-skeptic READY and run after the close.

amended.when: 2026-10-29 ~05:50 ET, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST (10 findings), before any held-out trade is priced.
amended.1_circularity: Report gross d and spread d next to net d. Add to pass: (5) removing LOW beats removing the same number of trades per session ranked by highest entry spread alone, and beats removing them by lowest range alone, each in >= 95% of seeded tie-broken draws. (6) The gross d is <= 0.
amended.2_bar_source: All 10 sessions use Alpaca historical IEX 1m bars (high/low, RTH 09:30-16:00, raw). Before scoring, recompute the 12-session exploration table with these bars and check 10/14-10/15 against the warehouse. Report agreement. If the exploration's < 8 split is not still negative on Alpaca bars, stop.
amended.3_fetch_errors: Separate a fetch error from no-data. Retry errors. If more than 5% of trades have an unresolved error, the run is VOID.
amended.4_bar_count: The 15-bar rule is dropped (the exploration had none).
amended.5_population: Count-stage gate: REF vs live fills on 10/27, giving recall and precision (same symbol, within 120 s), printed. The population is called 'replay trades at 10/27 config', not 'the desk's entries'. Information-only: the same split on actual live fills 10/14-10/27.
amended.6_contamination: HOLDS is required both with and without 10/27 (10/27-10/28 examples motivated the feature).
amended.7_t_bar: Pass (1) reads: mean d <= -5 bp with t <= -t_0.975(n-1).
amended.8_power: The count stage prints LOW n, the number of sessions with both groups, and the MDE (3.08 x sd_session(d) / sqrt(n) from a random-split placebo). If MDE > 10 bp, report UNDERPOWERED without scoring.
amended.9_criterion4: The book is LOW union REST (missing excluded). Means are session-equal-weighted, and draws remove trades within each session.
amended.10_meaning: HOLDS is an association only, never cited as an edge; a pass only earns the replay gate test in if_holds.

amended_2.when: 2026-10-29 ~06:10 ET, result-skeptic round 2 (FIX FIRST, text only), fix text applied verbatim, before any held-out trade is priced.
amended_2.R1_precedence: Where 'amended' conflicts with any earlier key, 'amended' governs. Pass = original (2), (3) + amended (1), (4 as in 9), (5), (6).
amended_2.R2_mde: Placebo: in each session, label at random as many trades as that session's actual LOW count (200 seeded draws, seed 'MTC-MDE'). Compute d per session and sd_session(d) per draw. MDE = (t_0.975(n-1) + t_0.80(n-1)) x median sd / sqrt(n), where n = sessions with both groups. Compute it for both sets (with and without 10/27). The count stage prints only the counts and the two MDEs: no LOW or REST mean, no gross, no net.
amended_2.R3_controls: (5) is a deterministic comparison: the session-equal book mean after removing LOW must strictly exceed the mean after removing the k widest-spread trades, and separately the mean after removing the k lowest-range trades. Ties at the cut are broken by seed 'MTC-TIE' (100 draws, must win in >= 95%). (6) stays as reported, information only; it is not a cost control.
amended_2.R4_recheck: Re-check = the exploration's 12 sessions on Alpaca IEX bars. The 48 formerly-missing trades now get a range, and their band shares are reported. Continue only if the exploration's session-equal mean d (LOW - REST net) is < 0. Otherwise STOP, label the split 'source-dependent', and price no held-out trade. Agreement on 10/14-10/15 = share of trades whose LOW/REST label matches the warehouse, reported; below 0.90 is a flag in the write-up.
amended_2.R5_gate: If 10/27 recall or precision is < 0.5, a HOLDS is labelled 'replay-only', and if_holds additionally requires the live-fill split d < 0. Live-fill prices come from the positions state (fill avg price), never from the trade log.
amended_2.R6_power_both_sets: The underpowered rule and the MDE apply to the without-10/27 set too. If either set is UNDERPOWERED, the verdict is UNDERPOWERED.
